notes: Blind answer matches key (لوحة : متحف). Relation: item and the place where such items are collected/kept. Distractors carry clearly different relations (maker:product, material:product, tool:used-with). Explanation correct. Aptitude item without pages, so support not_checked. Deterministic L003 warn: stem ends with the given pair after a colon, which is the standard analogy givens block, so no language change needed.

Blind answer matches key (معلّم : مدرسة). Relation: professional and workplace; distractors are professional:product, professional:goal, user:tool, none of which is a place. Explanation correct. Very familiar pair with no near-miss distractor, so I estimate 1 rather than 2 (within tolerance). Aptitude item without pages, support not_checked. L003 warn is the analogy givens-block format, acceptable.

Blind answer matches key (جوع : طعام). Relation: need and what satisfies it. Distractors are thing:source (مطر : سحاب), activity:place (نوم : سرير), condition:season (برد : شتاء); none is need:satisfier. Explanation correct (it calls نوم a فعل, loosely meaning an activity, which is acceptable). Difficulty 2 agreed. Aptitude item, no pages, support not_checked. L003 warn is the analogy givens-block format, acceptable.

Blind answer matches key (بقرة : حليب). Relation: creature and the food substance it produces for people. طائر : عُش is the intended lure (creature and something it makes), but a nest is a dwelling built from gathered material, not a produced food, and the explanation says exactly this, so the key remains the single best answer. Other distractors: animal:equipment, animal:sound. Explanation correct. Difficulty 2 agreed. Aptitude item, no pages, support not_checked. L003 warn is the analogy givens-block format, acceptable.

Blind answer matches key (كريم : بخيل). Relation: antonymy; it is the only antonym pair, and the other three are near-synonyms. Explanation correct. Because every distractor shares the same synonym relation, the key stands out at once, so I estimate 1 rather than 2 (within tolerance). Aptitude item, no pages, support not_checked. L003 warn is the analogy givens-block format, acceptable.

Blind answer matches key (يرقة : فراشة). Relation: early developmental stage and the mature form it becomes. All three distractors come from the plant domain, the same domain as بذرة : شجرة (part:what grows on it, part:location, thing:what it contains). The student must abstract away from that shared domain, which justifies difficulty 3. Explanation correct. Aptitude item, no pages, support not_checked. L003 warn is the analogy givens-block format, acceptable.

Blind answer matches key (ساعة : زمن). Relation: measuring instrument and the quantity it measures. Distractors are all tool:object pairs (tool:what it opens, tool:writing surface, device:power source), and none involves measurement. Explanation correct. Only one option is a measuring instrument, so the key is quick to identify; I estimate 2 against the stated 3, which is within tolerance. Aptitude item, no pages, support not_checked. L003 warn is the analogy givens-block format, acceptable.

Blind answer matches key (لاعب : فريق). Relation: individual member and the group they belong to. ربّان : سفينة is a mild lure (a person linked to an entity), but a captain leads a ship and is not a member of a group of captains. The other distractors are professional:client and source:product. Explanation correct. Member:group is a very familiar pattern, so I estimate 2 against the stated 3, which is within tolerance. Aptitude item, no pages, support not_checked. L003 warn is the analogy givens-block format, acceptable.

Aptitude item, no pages. Blind answer matches key (شروق : غروب): beginning and end of a thing. Distractors are clearly different relations (part/whole, synonyms, time and what appears in it), so one defensible answer. Explanation correct. Stage 1 L003 warn: stem ends with the analogy pair, the standard Qudurat analogy format, acceptable. Fairly direct relation; 2 may fit slightly better than 3.

Aptitude item, no pages. Blind answer matches key (إهمال : رسوب): blameworthy cause and its negative result. دواء : مرض is the reverse direction (remedy and what it treats), غيم : سماء is thing and place, صبر : تحمّل near-synonyms, so one defensible answer. Explanation correct. Stage 1 L003 warn is the standard analogy stem format, acceptable. Common cause-effect pattern; 2 may fit slightly better than 3.

Aptitude item, no pages. Blind answer matches key (خيّاط : قماش): craftsman and the raw material he works. Distractors are well-built near-misses (craftsman and tool, craftsman and product, operator and vehicle), each a distinct relation, so one defensible answer. Explanation correct and names each distractor relation accurately. Stage 1 L003 warn is the standard analogy stem format, acceptable. Difficulty 3 fits.

Aptitude item, no pages. Blind answer matches key (نسيم : إعصار): weak to strong degree of the same phenomenon, keeping the weak-to-strong direction. مطر : غيث is the closest trap but is a general/near-synonym pair with no clear intensity gradient, so one defensible answer. Explanation correct. Stage 1 L003 warn is the standard analogy stem format, acceptable. Vocabulary (رذاذ، وابل) raises the load; 3 to 4 is reasonable, 3 slightly more likely.

Aptitude item, no pages. Blind answer matches key (كريم : شُحّ): bearer of a virtue and the vice absent from him. عالِم : معرفة and شجاع : إقدام share the same (possessed-trait) relation, so they eliminate each other; مريض : دواء is condition and remedy. One defensible answer. Explanation correct and glosses شُحّ as البخل. Stage 1 L003 warn is the standard analogy stem format, acceptable. The possessed-trait traps help, but the pattern is recognisable; 3 may fit slightly better than 4.

Aptitude item, no pages. Blind answer matches key (مخطّط : مبنى): scaled drawing that represents a thing and its layout. Distractors are distinct relations (work and material, work and medium, instrument and what it indicates); تمثال : حجر is a reasonable representation trap but its second term is material, not the thing represented. One defensible answer. Explanation correct. Stage 1 L003 warn is the standard analogy stem format, acceptable. 3 to 4 is reasonable; 3 slightly more likely.

Aptitude item, no pages. Blind answer matches key (تقصيرًا من سائقه): the clause after بل states a cause (نتيجة عطل مفاجئ), so the negated slot must be a competing cause; the other options describe the delay (length, rarity, annoyance) and do not contrast with a cause. One defensible answer. Explanation correct; calling بل after negation أداة استدراك is standard in Qudurat prep. Stage 1 L003 warn: a sentence-completion stem ending with a full stop is the normal format, acceptable. Difficulty 3 fits.

Aptitude item, no pages. Blind answer matches key (وَجِلًا): the clause يخشى أن تخونه ذاكرته signals fear, and وَجِل means afraid. The other options (proud, sluggish, joyful) all clash with the fear cue. One defensible answer. Explanation correct with accurate glosses. Stage 1 L003 warn: a sentence-completion stem ending with a full stop is the normal format, acceptable. Difficulty 2 fits; the vocabulary word وَجِل is the only load.

Blind answer matches key (الشدّة, display 1). Aptitude item without pages, so support not_checked. The clause «حين يتخلّى عن المرء كثيرٌ من الناس» fixes the blank to a time of hardship; الرخاء والنجاح والفراغ contradict it, so one defensible answer. Explanation correct. Stage 1 L003 warn is a false positive for sentence completion: the blank sits mid-sentence and the stem correctly ends with a full stop, not ؟. Arabic is correct. Easy item; difficulty 2 is acceptable (borderline 1).

Blind answer matches key (تُبخِّرَ, display 1). Aptitude item without pages, so support not_checked. «قبل أن تمتصّه الجذور» signals losing the water, which only evaporation causes; تُضيء وتُدفئ وتُلوّن do not remove water, so one defensible answer. Verb forms are correctly منصوب after حتى لا. Explanation correct. Stage 1 L003 warn is a false positive: mid-sentence blank, stem correctly ends with a full stop. Difficulty 2 fits.

Blind answer matches key (لا يعود, display 1). Aptitude item without pages, so support not_checked. «لا يُعوَّض» and «مهما حاولنا استرجاعه» both point to irretrievability; لا يتوقّف describes time's flow not what has passed, لا يُهدَر and لا يُنسى do not fit the concessive clause, so one defensible answer. Explanation correct; the لا يُنسى rationale is compressed but sound. Stage 1 L003 warn is a false positive: mid-sentence blank, stem correctly ends with a full stop. Arabic correct. Difficulty 2 fits.

Blind answer matches key (شُحِّ, display 2). Aptitude item without pages, so support not_checked. «على الرغم من» requires an obstacle; وفرة وتنوّع وجودة are all enablers, so شُحّ is the only defensible answer. Genitive after من correctly marked on all options. Explanation correct. Stage 1 L003 warn is a false positive: mid-sentence blank, stem correctly ends with a full stop. Difficulty: labelled 3, I estimate 2 since the concessive cue is explicit and only one option is negative; not a blocker.

Blind answer matches key (جديدةً – قابلةً, display 0). Aptitude item without pages, so support not_checked. «لا يكفي أن تكون…» needs a desirable but insufficient first quality; قديمة ومكرّرة وغامضة are undesirable, so one defensible answer. Explanation correct and matches this reasoning. Observation: all four second words (قابلة، مناسبة، صالحة، جاهزة) fit «للتطبيق», so only the first blank discriminates; the item works but is easier than a true two-blank item, hence estimate 2 vs labelled 3. Stage 1 L003 warn is a false positive (mid-sentence blanks, full stop at end). Arabic correct.

Blind answer matches key (دقّق, display 2). Aptitude item without pages, so support not_checked. «لم يكتفِ… بل» plus «بيَّن ما لها وما عليها» require close scrutiny; تهاون وتسرّع contradict it and زهِد فيها (turned away from them) cannot precede weighing them, so one defensible answer. Explanation correct, though the rejection of تهاون/زهِد is brief. Stage 1 L003 warn is a false positive (mid-sentence blank, full stop at end). Arabic correct. Labelled 3; I estimate 2 as the key is the only positive verb, acceptable either way.

Blind answer matches key (التفكير المستمر, display 1). Aptitude item without pages, so support not_checked. The «كما… » simile requires the counterpart of exercise, i.e. active use of the mind; الراحة الطويلة والعزلة التامة are its opposite. الغذاء الوفير is the only tempting distractor (the brain needs nutrition), but it does not parallel التمرين and العقل here means intellect, so one defensible answer. Explanation correct. Stage 1 L003 warn is a false positive (mid-sentence blank, full stop at end). Arabic correct. Labelled 3; I estimate 2.

Blind answer matches key (موجزًا, display 2). Aptitude item without pages, so support not_checked. «دقائق معدودة» rules out مُسهبًا, and «أوصل فكرته كاملةً» rules out مُبهَمًا ومتلعثمًا, so one defensible answer. Explanation correct and covers every distractor. Stage 1 L003 warn is a false positive (mid-sentence blank, full stop at end). Arabic correct, accusative tanween on all options. Labelled 3; I estimate 2 (مُسهب is the only vocabulary hurdle), acceptable.

Blind answer matches key (ارتجاليةً). The concessive frame على الرغم من ... فإنها في الحقيقة forces a word opposite to دراسة متأنية; only ارتجالية fits. Explanation correct. Stage 1 L003 warn is a false positive: sentence-completion stem is a statement with a mid-sentence blank, so ending with a period is correct. Difficulty 4 looks one level high for an explicit contrast cue; 3 suggested.

issues.suggestion: Lower to 2: the item paraphrases the familiar saying about not judging a book by its cover, and the second clause (أنيق الغلاف ... المضمون) signals the contrast directly, so a strong student answers it at once.

notes: Blind answer matches key (غلافه – ضحلِ). Only this pair both names the cover and contrasts elegant cover with poor content; رصين keeps cover and content in agreement, and the other pairs fail the first blank. Case endings (كتابٍ أنيقِ ... ضحلِ) correct after كم الخبرية. Explanation correct. Stage 1 L003 warn is a false positive for an exclamatory sentence-completion stem.

Blind answer matches key (زكيّة). Burnt food, blackened pot and opening the windows all require a bad smell, so زكيّة is the only word at odds with the context; ترك, احترق and فأسرع fit. Explanation correct. Stage 1 warns are false positives for this format: O006 (every option appears in the stem by design of contextual-error items) and L003 (instruction line ends with a colon followed by the sentence). Options kept in sentence order (fixed_order_reason source_order) is appropriate.

Blind answer matches key (الخفيفة). Severe cold, snow and lighting heaters require warm clothing, so الخفيفة is the only word that contradicts the context; حرص, القرية and إشعال fit. Explanation correct (صوابها الثقيلة). Stage 1 O006 and L003 warns are format false positives for contextual-error items. Difficulty 2 acceptable; it is at the easy end (could be 1).

Blind answer matches key (يشكّ). الأمين, يُقبلون and يُوصون together with ولذلك all point to trust; changing only يشكّ to يثق makes the sentence consistent, whereas treating any other word as the error would need several further changes, so there is one defensible answer. Explanation correct. Stage 1 O006 and L003 warns are format false positives for contextual-error items.

Blind answer matches key (الظلام). Lightning lights the sky and the child shuts his eyes against sudden glare, so the cause must be strong light, not darkness; أضاء cannot be the error because lightning does not darken the sky, and أغمض/فتحهما are consistent. Explanation correct. Stage 1 O006 and L003 warns are format false positives for contextual-error items.

Blind answer matches key (تُسرف). Scarce rain and storing water in stems both demand conserving water, so تُسرف directly contradicts تختزن; تكثر reads correctly as such plants predominating in the desert, so it is not a competing answer. Explanation correct (صوابها تقتصد). Stage 1 O006 and L003 warns are format false positives for contextual-error items. Difficulty 3 is acceptable, though it sits nearer 2.

Blind answer matches key (يتسرّع). الحِلم and hearing all parties before judging both signal deliberation, so يتسرّع is the only word that contradicts the context; making الحِلم the error would leave يستمع ... قبل أن يقضي inconsistent. Explanation correct (صوابها يتأنّى). Difficulty 3 fits, since the reader must know the meaning of الحِلم. Stage 1 O006 and L003 warns are format false positives for contextual-error items.

Blind answer matches key (التزام). Congestion causes lateness, not punctuality, and the closing clause «للحدّ من التأخّر» confirms it; ازدحام، اعتماد، للحدّ all fit. Explanation correct: «إخلال» works with «بمواعيد», and «تأخّر» needs «عن». Aptitude item with no pages, so support is not_checked. Stage 1 warnings: O006 (option words appear in the stem) is inherent to contextual-error items; L003 (stem ends with a full stop, not ؟) is acceptable because the stem is an instruction plus a sentence. Difficulty 2-3: the final clause gives the answer away. The labelled 3 is defensible.

issues.span: و«أنجع الوسائل» لا تُقال إلا في علاج مشكلة
issues.suggestion: Soften the claim, since «أنجع» (most effective) is used for any goal, not only remedies. For example: «ووصفُ التشجير بأنه من أنجع الوسائل يدلّ على أنه علاجٌ لمشكلة لا سببٌ لها».
Consider difficulty 2. The mismatch between afforestation and «تسريع التصحّر» is immediate, and the other three words support each other.

notes: Blind answer matches key (لتسريع). Tree roots fix the soil and protect it from erosion, so afforestation fights desertification. تُثبّت، تحميها، الانجراف are all consistent. The key and the correction «لمكافحة» are right; only the absolute wording about «أنجع» is overstated. Aptitude item with no pages, so support is not_checked. Stage 1 warnings O006 and L003 are inherent to the contextual-error format.

Blind answer matches key (يسهُل). The thinner air, the lower oxygen intake and the oxygen cylinders all show that breathing is harder at altitude. «يخِفّ» is the plausible trap, but it is the stated cause and fits. تُعينهم and مواصلة fit. The explanation, with its correction «يصعُب» and its note on «يخِفّ», is correct and scientifically accurate. Aptitude item with no pages, so support is not_checked. Stage 1 warnings O006 and L003 are inherent to the contextual-error format. Difficulty 2-3; the labelled 3 is defensible because of the «يخِفّ» trap.

issues.suggestion: Lower the difficulty to 2 (at most 3). The sentence is short and «يستوعبه منها و«يُهمله» joins two opposites with «و» in a sentence about benefiting from books, so a strong student spots the error at once. The other three words fit plainly.

notes: Blind answer matches key (يُهمله). The «لا ... بل» structure moves the measure of culture from quantity to real benefit, and neglecting the books contradicts that. «يُطبّقه/يوظّفه» are good corrections. The explanation is correct and the language is sound. Aptitude item with no pages, so support is not_checked. Stage 1 warnings O006 and L003 are inherent to the contextual-error format. The only issue is the difficulty label; its 4 also makes the item high_risk without need.

Blind answer matches key (الجزم). The results «تضاءل يقينه» and «كثرت أسئلته» need a cause of questioning, not certainty. Changing «تضاءل» instead would leave «كثرت أسئلته» in conflict, so there is only one defensible answer. The explanation covers the «تضاءل» trap correctly, and «التساؤل» is a good correction. Aptitude item with no pages, so support is not_checked. Stage 1 warnings O006 and L003 are inherent to the contextual-error format. Difficulty 3-4: the counter-intuitive idea makes «تضاءل» an attractive trap, so the labelled 4 is defensible.

Blind answer matches key (أسى, display index 3). سرور، حُبور، بهجة are near-synonyms for joy, and أسى means sorrow. No competing grouping (form, root or pattern) produces a different odd word. The explanation is correct and concise. Aptitude item with no pages, so support is not_checked. Difficulty 1-2: the less common «حُبور» is the only thing that raises it. The labelled 2 is right.

Blind answer matches key (غزال, display index 3). Lion, tiger and cheetah are carnivorous big cats (السنّوريات), and the gazelle is a herbivore and their prey. The only other surface feature, letter count (غزال has 4 letters, the others 3), points to the same option, so there is no ambiguity. The explanation is correct. Aptitude item with no pages, so support is not_checked. Difficulty 1-2: very easy, but the labelled 2 is acceptable.

Blind answer matches key (خشب, display index 2). Gold, silver and copper are metals, and wood is a plant material. The alternative split (precious ذهب/فضّة vs non-precious نحاس/خشب) is 2-2 and gives no single odd word, so there is no ambiguity. The explanation is correct. Aptitude item with no pages, so support is not_checked. Difficulty 1-2: very easy, but the labelled 2 is acceptable.

issues.suggestion: شجاعة/جسارة/إقدام are common, transparent synonyms and حكمة is clearly a different meaning; difficulty 2 fits better.

notes: Blind answer matches key (حكمة). Aptitude item with no pages, so support not_checked. Single defensible answer: the other three are synonyms for courage. Explanation is correct and clear; Arabic is sound. Only concern is difficulty slightly overstated.

issues.suggestion: The receive-vs-produce split (قرأ/طالع/تصفّح vs كتب) is immediate for most students; difficulty 2 fits better.

notes: Blind answer matches key (كتب). Aptitude item with no pages, so support not_checked. No competing morphological grouping singles out another option (قرأ/كتب are both bare trilateral, طالع/تصفّح both augmented), so one defensible answer. Explanation correct; Arabic sound.

issues.suggestion: The offensive-vs-defensive split (درع vs سيف/رمح/خنجر) is a very familiar category contrast; difficulty 2 fits better.

notes: Blind answer matches key (درع). Aptitude item with no pages, so support not_checked. A weaker grouping (رمح as a pole weapon vs bladed hand weapons) does not single it out cleanly, since درع is the only non-weapon of attack; one defensible answer. Explanation correct; Arabic sound.

issues.suggestion: تذكّر also carries the sense of اتّعاظ/اعتبار (e.g. «إنما يتذكّر أولو الألباب»), close to تدبّر/تفكّر; add a clause to the explanation saying the item uses its primary sense of recalling the past, or swap in a clearer outlier such as «ينسى».

notes: Blind answer matches key (يتذكّر). Aptitude item with no pages, so support not_checked. Key is the best answer: three verbs of active reflection vs one of memory recall; all share the تفعّل pattern so no morphological distractor. Explanation correct; Arabic sound. Difficulty 3 is right.

issues.suggestion: سَهَر and أرَق are everyday words and رُقاد is transparent from رقد, so the antonym outlier is found quickly even if سُهاد is unfamiliar; difficulty 3 fits better.

notes: Blind answer matches key (رُقاد). Aptitude item with no pages, so support not_checked. The voluntary (سهر) vs involuntary (أرق/سهاد) nuance does not compete, since رُقاد is the only word meaning sleep itself; one defensible answer. Explanation correct; vocalisation and Arabic sound.

Blind answer matches key (مكانة النخلة قديمًا وحديثًا). Aptitude item with no pages, so support not_checked; the key is fully grounded in the stimulus, which moves from old uses and resilience to modern industry. The three distractors are each a single supporting detail of the passage, so one defensible answer. Explanation correct; Arabic sound; difficulty 2 is right.

issues.suggestion: The stem quotes «رفيقة الإنسان», which sits in the same clause as the key phrase verbatim, so this is direct detail lookup; difficulty 2 fits better (or paraphrase the stem/key to raise it).

notes: Blind answer matches key (تحمّل الحرارة وملوحة التربة). Aptitude item with no pages, so support not_checked; the stimulus states the cause explicitly. The benefits distractor is correctly excluded by «لم تكن هذه المنافع وحدها»; the water distractor contradicts the passage. Explanation correct; Arabic sound.

Blind answer matches key (تجاوزت الاستهلاك المحلي إلى التجارة العالمية). Aptitude item with no pages, so support not_checked; the key follows from the stimulus (factories packing and exporting dates to distant markets). The «لم تعد غذاءً» distractor is a fair trap on the past-tense «ما كان قوتًا» but is unsupported; one defensible answer. Explanation correct; Arabic sound; difficulty 3 fits an inference-from-phrase item.

Aptitude reading item; the key is stated explicitly in the passage (يُثبّت المهمّ منه في الذاكرة طويلة المدى). Distractors are clearly contradicted or unsupported; option 3 is a good near-miss (كل ما اكتسبه دون تمييز vs المهمّ منه). Explanation correct; Arabic is sound.

Aptitude phrase-meaning item; key is the only reading consistent with the contrast in the passage (توزيع المراجعة ... أجدى من حشو المعلومات). Two distractors restate the opposite method named in the passage, so the item is slightly easier than the labelled 3; 2 seems closer, within tolerance. Explanation correct; Arabic is sound.

Aptitude inference item; key is a close paraphrase of قد يحفظ كمًّا كبيرًا ... لكنه قد يجد صعوبة في استرجاعها. Distractors are over-generalisations or a reversal (the passage keeps memorising possible and makes retrieval the problem), so exactly one answer is defensible. The key paraphrases a single sentence, so 3 seems closer than the labelled 4; within tolerance. Explanation correct; Arabic is sound.

Aptitude detail item; key is stated in the opening sentence (بساعات سطوع شمسي طويلة ... يجعلها من أنسب البيئات). Distractors invert the stated challenges (dust, heat) or add something the passage does not claim (plentiful water). Explanation quote and reasoning are accurate; Arabic is sound.

Aptitude text-structure item; the contrast marker غير أنّ follows the advantages (sunshine, no emissions) and introduces dust and heat as challenges, so only the key fits. Solutions come in the final sentence, so the solution distractor is clearly wrong. The explicit marker makes it a bit easier than the labelled 3; 2 seems closer, within tolerance.
